- No systemic symptoms of anemia (supports chronic, non-hemolytic, non-acute blood loss)

- Negative medication review for antiplatelet/anticoagulant agents (rules out acquired cause)  
- Normal platelet count (160,000/mm³) — excludes thrombocytopenia as cause of bleeding time prolongation

- Prolonged bleeding time (6 min) — indicates impaired primary hemostasis (platelet adhesion/aggregation), characteristic of VWD, not hemophilia A  
- Mild anemia (Hct 35%) — consistent with chronic mucosal blood loss
